newsitem.title: USA: Ramsay Health sets shareholder vote.
newsitem.headline: Ramsay Health sets shareholder vote.

text.p: Ramsay Health Care Inc and Ramsay Managed Care Inc said on Monday that they will each hold a special meeting of stockholders on April 18 for a shareholder vote on their merger.
The companies said they each had established February 28 as the record date for determining the stockholders entitled to vote at the special meetings.

Corporate affiliates of Paul Ramsay, chairman of each company, will vote in favor of the merger, the companies said. Ramsay's affiliates hold 69 percent of Ramsay Managed Care and 34.5 percent of Ramsay Health Care, the companies said.
